lexicon.0.0001 ZEC: zero point zero zero zero one [ZEC](/zˈɛk/)

segments.name: e2-open

params.title: Swap in the app or buy on an exchange
params.line: Zodl was called Zashi in older guides

narration: By the end of this video, ZEC will be on its way to your wallet. There are two ways to get it.

segments.name: e2-routes
narration: Route one: swap crypto you already have, right inside Zodl. Route two: buy ZEC on an exchange and send it to your wallet.

segments.name: e2-swap

params.label: Diagram, not the app
params.definition: Shielded: the amount, the sender and the receiver are encrypted on the blockchain

narration: Route one. On the home screen, tap Swap. You can swap other crypto into shielded ZEC right inside Zodl.
Shielded means the amount, the sender and the receiver are encrypted on the blockchain.
The swap uses NEAR Intents, not a centralized exchange.

segments.name: e2-exchange

params.label: Illustration
params.definition: Transparent: public on the blockchain, like Bitcoin. Addresses start with t
params.chip: Zodl will offer to shield it

narration: Route two. Buy ZEC on an exchange, then withdraw it to your wallet.
Most exchanges only send ZEC to a transparent address. Transparent means public on the blockchain, like Bitcoin.
That is fine. Zodl will offer to shield it when it arrives.

segments.name: e2-receive
narration: To find your address, tap Receive. Your Zcash Shielded Address starts with u1. Zodl shows a new one each time. They all lead to the same wallet.
Below it is your Zcash Transparent Address. It starts with t1. If an exchange will not accept your u1 address, give it the t1 address.

segments.name: e2-arrive
narration: Now wait a little. New ZEC needs 10 confirmations, about 12 and a half minutes, before you can spend it.
When it lands, Zodl shows Wallet Backup Required. You already wrote your words down. Follow the steps from episode 1.

segments.name: e2-site
narration: Tick Getting ZEC on the site.

segments.name: e2-end
narration: Next, episode 3: shielding, so your ZEC goes private. See you at zero-to-shielded.vercel.app.

upload.title: Getting ZEC: swap in the app or buy on an exchange | Zero to Shielded 2
upload.description:
Get your first ZEC on its way to your Zodl wallet. ZEC is the coin of Zcash. You can swap crypto you already have right inside Zodl or buy ZEC on an exchange. This is episode 2 of Zero to Shielded.

Watch the series and tick your progress: https://zero-to-shielded.vercel.app

In this episode:
- Route one: on the home screen, tap Swap. You can swap other crypto into shielded ZEC right inside Zodl. The swap uses NEAR Intents, not a centralized exchange.
- Shielded means the amount, the sender and the receiver are encrypted on the blockchain.
- Route two: buy ZEC on an exchange, then withdraw it to your wallet. Most exchanges only send ZEC to a transparent address. Transparent means public on the blockchain, like Bitcoin. Zodl will offer to shield it when it arrives.
- Tap Receive to find your addresses. Your Zcash Shielded Address starts with u1. Your Zcash Transparent Address starts with t1.
- New ZEC needs 10 confirmations, about 12 and a half minutes, before you can spend it.

Chapters:
{chapters}

Wallet steps are shown as labelled step diagrams with the exact button names from the Zodl app, not as drawings of the app. Every fact is sourced in docs/FACTS.md. No recovery phrase appears on screen.

Zodl was called Zashi in older guides.

Zodl: https://zodl.com/
Zodl support: https://support.zodl.com/

Video, narration and script: CC BY-ND 4.0. Repost with credit, no edits.

Scripts, narration and editing were produced with AI assistance (Kiro). Narration is a synthesised voice (Kokoro, Apache-2.0). Music is original and generated in code.
